correctness.rationale: Writing X_i=u_i^p, h=1−f and f=θ∏(1−X_i), each mixed derivative acts by (1+D_i) with D_i=pX_i∂_i. For distinct i the product rule gives the numerator over h⁴: h³ plus h² times the sum of all nonempty distinct-index derivatives of f, plus 2h times the pair products of single derivatives and the three single-times-complementary-double derivative products, plus 6 times the product of the three singles. Each factor is multilinear spatially and linear in θ, so all three spatial degrees and the θ-degree are at most three. Independently confirmed the four corner identities and converted exact values at the tensor nodes {0,1/3,2/3,1} to Bernstein coefficients by inverting the evaluation matrix (not the supplied monomial-coefficient transform). With q=1+r, the two admissible interval parametrizations have p=1/q, θ=−q²+s(1+q²) and p=q, θ=(−q+s(q+1))/q³. Clearing denominators by q³ and q⁹ respectively gives polynomials in r with nonnegative coefficients for all 80 independent Bernstein indices in each regime. This establishes the continuum sign exactly. A pole at an interior diagonal point rules out θ>1, and the corner limits at (1,1,0) and (1,1,1) rule out θ<−p⁻² and θ>p⁻³ by negative interior mixed density. In range h>0 in the interior; if θ=1, p≤1 and h≥max(u,v,w), so C≤min(u,v,w) and the origin extends continuously. Nonnegative interior mixed density gives nonnegative box volumes up to the boundary by continuity. Grounding and product bivariate margins are explicit; at nonzero θ any interior value differs from the product of all three coordinates.
residual_risks: The certificate is finite and exact for this symmetric trivariate form only. It is not a classification for unequal powers or more than three coordinates.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A conventional strict Archimedean AMH extension with a non-product bivariate margin is not this pure three-way family. More generally a strict Archimedean copula with product bivariate margins would have a continuous generator satisfying ψ(x+y)=ψ(x)ψ(y), hence be joint independence. An AMH label alone does not distinguish these cases; prior coverage of the unpowered expression is credited independently of the label.

value.rationale: The model isolates three-way dependence while fixing all pair marginals at independence. The exact interval is consequential for using the model: parameters outside it cause a pole or a negative local probability, despite the apparently valid product margins. The asymmetric negative and positive frontiers and the upper-bound transition at p=1 are not a reparameterization of the p=1 result. The certificate gives a usable exact test for tuning the power and interaction jointly.
residual_risks: No empirical advantage, broader dependence classification, or higher-dimensional theorem follows.
